answer: The spiral counter is kept in gale and cedar reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3396 identities would post 3190 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
